description: `cleanUrls` array form with a negation pattern. `!/secret/**` enables cleanUrls (extension stripping + extensionless resolution) for every path that does NOT match `/secret/**`, mirroring `slasher`'s `!`-preservation at `serve-handler/src/glob-slash.js:8` plus minimatch's per-pattern negate semantics with `nonegate: false` (the default at `serve-handler/src/index.js:59`). Backs SRV-ROUT-001 (array-form 301 scope, negation form) and SRV-ROUT-002 (extensionless resolution under negation). Closes Codex review round 2 P1.
